rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for “yesterday” in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: Yesterday I went to the wet market to buy ingredients.
example.jyutping: kam4 jat6 ngo5 heoi3 zo2 gaai1 si5 maai5 sung3

rows.note: Use this common colloquial variant when referring to the day before today.

example.english: Did you watch that movie yesterday?
example.traditional: 尋日你有冇睇嗰套戲呀？
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 go2 tou3 hei3 aa3

rows.note: Use this formal or written alternative rather than the everyday spoken forms.

example.jyutping: zok3 jat6 ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai4 gaau1 bou3 gou3
